page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with single-threaded execution per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and virtualized resources via the KVM hypervisor. Network performance is anchored by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1576.79 and a multi-core score of 33292.22. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read-only small block throughput of 1856.41 GB/sec, which drops to 114.67 GB/sec for uncached large block reads, and 53.49 GB/sec for large block writes. In application-specific workloads, the instance demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 23.96 GB/sec and processes 31.14 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. Software compilation via Clang scores 25676.0 on Geekbench, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 149.11 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g7ne.8xlarge offers a standard general-purpose hardware profile with dedicated CPU allocation. The lack of bundled local storage means users must factor in the latency and cost of network-attached storage. Similarly, the absence of a GPU limits its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning. However, the 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio make it a reliable option for database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
